title: The Bonds of Justice
text: Oh? What happened to the bonds of justice, I wonder? By my estimation, I'd figured Itsuki's companions would at least try to hide Itsuki's appearance while going about their business. Ren's companions, being the earnest sort, were operating with Rafumi's support, and even so, they were giving Ren a certain degree of consideration. I'd expected a similarly structured operation from Itsuki's group, just with somewhat lower quality care.

“To explain that matter, I first need to explain how I ended up looking like this. Ren-san, you must know who did this to you too, don't you? Since you've already explained the circumstances to Naofumi-san.”
“No, I don't. I went out hunting to prepare for the next wave, and suddenly lost consciousness. When I came to, I was in this form, in some cargo that had arrived at Zeltoble.”
Upon hearing Ren's explanation, Itsuki let out a deep sigh.
“Hah… so you were caught by a surprise attack. What a foolish story.”
“What did you say? Itsuki, the way you're talking, it sounds like you know who turned us into this!”
“Yes, I know. In fact, they showed themselves openly and even gave their name.”
“Is that so! Tell me! Who is it! Who turned us into this!”
Ren clenched his fists at the interrogation.

“Yes, I won't forget it. That fellow suddenly appeared in the room I was staying in that day. They called themselves usaunny, paralyzed me, and said, ‘I thought I'd teach you the truth of this country, since you've been dancing to its tune and getting carried away with yourself, deshipyo~n,’ and that's how I ended up like this.”

Ren seemed to hold his breath as he listened to Itsuki's words, as though learning of some shocking new form the enemy could take. Incidentally, Father and everyone else listening to the story kept turning their eyes toward me for some reason, indeed. Their expressions were oddly sorrowful, unable to be described.
“This one calling itself usaunny had a rabbit-like appearance, just as the name suggests, and wore the same Santa hat on its head as me.”
“Dancing to the country's tune and getting carried away with yourself. That is indeed a fact, I say.”
At my words, Father and everyone around him furrowed their brows and blinked repeatedly, but it was a fact nonetheless, indeed.
“Yes… that's right. If you're speaking of that point, then there's no mistake. By becoming this form, I came to witness the truth quite literally.”
Oh? It seems he's learned his lesson properly. Well done, I say.
“Um… Itsuki, so… what should we call that form of yours?”
“It seems to be a creature called riska. Though Ren-san's species is apparently a different type, you've both become similar creatures.”
“Ah.”
“What's this, what's this? Did you two come back?”
At this point Keel poked her head in, and Itsuki looked back and forth between Ren and Keel, furrowing her brow and blinking.
“Wow, more cute ones!”
Luna-chan was all smiles.
“So there are similar species. In that case, it becomes difficult to simply assume who the culprit is.”
“Hey. What did you look at to make that judgment!”
“What's wrong?”
Keel and Ren really do look alike, indeed. With just a slightly different pattern, it wouldn't be strange to call them the same species. Incidentally, Luna-chan sometimes puts a Santa hat on Keel.
“The conversation's drifting. And then what happened?”
“Yes, that's right. As for what happened—”
So saying, Itsuki began to recount what happened after I'd turned him into a riska.
Itsuki, unable to move as he watched the one calling itself usaunny depart with a triumphant laugh, apparently lay collapsed there until the paralysis wore off, indeed.
“Guh… hah… hah. Finally, the numbness is gone.”
As soon as he could move, Itsuki pulled a paralysis-curing medicine from his bow, took it, and treated himself, then rose slowly and left the room to head to his companions, it seems.
“Mald, Rojiiru! Everyone! This is an emergency!”
Itsuki hurried to where the Smoked Meats were holding their feast, indeed.
“Wahahaha! Ahh? What's this filthy Demi-Human?”
“What business do you have with us, huh?”
“Sheesh, this is a sacred tavern for great humans like us to enjoy, you know?”
“Do you not realize how out of place you are, coming to a spot like this, you lowly creature!”
And so, it seems a rough welcome awaited him from his drunken, carousing companions.

“You all… I'll need to have a word with you about that attitude later, but listen to me. I've ended up in this form, but I'm Itsuki Kawasumi, the Bow Hero. Just now, a Demi-Human calling itself usaunny cast some mysterious spell on me and turned me into this.”

Though quite irritated, Itsuki explained the circumstances, hoping to rely on his companions given the gravity of the situation. The drunken Smoked Meats apparently exchanged blank looks before turning to face Itsuki. Then the male mage among Itsuki's companions, one called Werner, approached and roughly patted Itsuki's head a few times, indeed.
“Sure, there are spells out there that change your appearance, but the kind that break easily enough if you move around vigorously.”
And with that, his pats turned into rather forceful smacks on Itsuki's head, indeed.

“Ow, ow! Werner! I understand now that such magic exists, but that's beside the point! Never mind that, I'm telling you all this is an emergency! I don't even know the method to undo it or how to treat it myself.”
“Ahh!? Of all things, to dare claim to be that insolent brat!”
The Smoked Meat apparently grabbed Itsuki by the collar and hoisted him up, shouting at him for continuing to make a fuss.
“Insolent brat? Mald… is that really how you've thought of me all this time?”
Feeling irritation rise at his companions' language and attitude, Itsuki apparently responded while suppressing his anger, indeed.

“Ah, seriously, it gets so tiresome, justice this, justice that. And on top of it, that princess kept whispering about how the shield devil was using the Demi-Humans as slaves, which made things such a hassle.”
“Getting beaten to a pulp, looking so uncool, and on top of that turning into a magic shield, it was downright comical. I had a hard time holding back my laughter.”

“Don't say that to him. Haha, he seems like such a young master type, trying to bring the shield devil to justice, and I thought for sure he'd properly kill him, but turns out he couldn't even do that.”
“You all…”
At this point, it seems Itsuki's anger had already built up quite a bit. Well, showing your true colors so quickly just from changing your appearance is beyond foolish, indeed.
“If you don't believe I'm the Bow Hero, then how about this? First, check the party status!”

He apparently showed them, changing the shape of the bow he carried as proof of being a hero, shifting it back and forth. Well, there are a fair number of weapons in this world with gimmicks that mimic the transformations of a hero's weapon. And as if to prove it further, he apparently knocked off the helmet the Smoked Meat was wearing.
“Wha— this guy—”
Startled by the unexpected counterattack, the Smoked Meat released his grip on Itsuki, letting him land properly, indeed.
“Do you understand now? No matter what form I take, I am still myself.”

Surely they'd listen now. First, he'd investigate a way back to his original form, then give them a proper scolding afterward. That seems to have been his plan. Well, if it were Ren's companions, they likely could've told it was Ren just from that much. Even if it were Father, his slaves, Big Sister, or Filo-tan, I'm sure they would've figured it out too. …Would it be a different situation, like when Older Sister or Panda brought someone back? No, it seems they'd definitely understood it was Father. The only one who hadn't understood was Tiger Guy, given how distant that relationship was.
“Yeah, yeah. You're saying you're Itsuki-sama, right? I get your skill now.”
The woman among Itsuki's companions apparently smiled at him, believing him.
“Finally, you understand.”
“Yeah, yeah. I get it, you're Itsuki-sama, right?”
Though the slightly flat, deadpan delivery bothered him quite a bit, Itsuki tried to press on with the conversation rather than pointing it out, figuring there'd be no end to it if he did, indeed.
“In any case, I believe that usaunny fellow is still somewhere around here, so everyone, we need to hurry and find them so they can turn me back.”
“So then, what exactly does this usaunny look like?”
“About the same height as I am now, with a ridiculous Santa hat on its head—”
Just as he said this, Itsuki felt a shadow fall behind him and turned to look, but the next instant, a jolt of impact struck his head with a thud, indeed.
Apparently, standing behind him were a Smoked Meat and a warrior. According to Itsuki, once he turned around, they'd struck him with something like an axe or a blunt weapon.
“Mald, Rojiiru… wh-what are you…”
“Alright! One down!”
“Fuhahaha… this'll fetch a good price for tonight's drinks.”
“A bonus round! Don't you dare tell Itsuki-sama about this.”
“Obviously.”
And with that, Itsuki apparently lost consciousness completely.
